notes: IAS Regulation (EC) No 1606/2002, consolidated consolidated version. The governing statutory text for the EU member-state IFRS obligation and the Article 4 / Article 5 options. Read for the P1 carve-out check (decision D-038).

Commission Regulation (EU) 2026/338 of 13 February 2026 endorsing IFRS 18, amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1803. Article 2: application from the first financial year beginning on or after 1 January 2027. Article 3: 'binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States' - the operative clause for the P1 carve-out check.

Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/1803 - the codifying regulation whose Annex 2026/338 amends. Establishes that the EU adopts IFRS Accounting Standards in full, in bulk, as a single annex; there is no mechanism in it for a member state to opt out of an individual endorsed standard for its listed consolidated reporters.

IFRS Foundation jurisdiction profile for the European Union, re-read for the P1 check. Confirms the mandatory consolidated-IFRS rule and enumerates the Member State Option (Article 5 of the IAS Regulation) as the ONLY discretion left to member states.

IFAC Country Profile - Poland, read for the P1 check as the known derogation case. Confirms Poland requires EU-endorsed IFRS for consolidated statements of all domestic publicly accountable entities, and that the only discretion exercised is the Article 5 option over WHICH ENTITIES may apply IFRS, not over WHICH STANDARDS.
